details.sql:
WITH metric_source AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) AS revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Gross Profit' THEN value END) AS gross_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Operating Income' THEN value END) AS operating_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Net Income' THEN value END) AS net_income
  FROM comp_financials
  WHERE
    metric IN ('Revenue','Gross Profit','Operating Income','Net Income')
    AND ticker IN ('NVDA','AMD','INTC','MU','QCOM','AVGO','TXN') AND calendar_year >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 5
  GROUP BY
    ticker,
    calendar_year
  HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN metric = 'Revenue' THEN value END) > 0
),
margins AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    CASE WHEN revenue > 0 THEN (gross_profit / revenue) * 100.0 ELSE NULL END AS gross_margin,
    CASE WHEN revenue > 0 THEN (operating_income / revenue) * 100.0 ELSE NULL END AS operating_margin,
    CASE WHEN revenue > 0 THEN (net_income / revenue) * 100.0 ELSE NULL END AS net_margin
  FROM metric_source
),
growth AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    calendar_year,
    operating_margin - LAG(operating_margin, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY calendar_year) AS operating_margin_change_pp
  FROM margins
),
peer_avg AS (
  SELECT
    calendar_year,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ticker <> 'NVDA' THEN operating_margin_change_pp END) AS peer_avg_operating_margin_change_pp
  FROM growth
  GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT
  calendar_year,
  g.ticker,
  g.operating_margin_change_pp AS company_operating_margin_change_pp,
  p.peer_avg_operating_margin_change_pp AS peer_avg_operating_margin_change_pp
FROM growth g
JOIN peer_avg p USING (calendar_year)
WHERE g.ticker = 'NVDA'
ORDER BY calendar_year
LIMIT 500
